title: Replayed-from-cache step against a changed app version
closed: #41 binds validation evidence to the approved build (validation build_digest, rechecked after the run and at promote) and to a Kane run started during this validation (kane_runs; a cached observation is <id>:stale_kane_run). Receipts reject evidence from another build or Kane run, and a VerifiedRunReceipt needs both bindings. #44 puts the build on BrowserObservation itself: KaneBrowserRunner stamps the build it measured around its own run (None if it changed or could not be measured), validation fails <id>:observation_build_mismatch / <id>:observation_build_missing, and promotion refuses evidence observed on another build. BrowserObservation.receipt_evidence fills a receipt's evidence build from the observation, so a receipt made from a cached observation names the build Kane saw.
